decisions.reason: s0068 has 鎮鄯州; 鄯州 is Shanzhou, not Zhengzhou (鄭州), and the following Huanghe posting fits the western corridor.
Same unit reads 鎮鄯州; the literal must match Shanzhou rather than Zhengzhou.
s0076 has 自檜鎮鄯州; the place is again Shanzhou, and replacing Zhengzhou corrects a clear naming error without other changes.
Literal of s0076 likewise mistranslates 鄯州 as Zhengzhou; Shanzhou is the accurate reading.
s0086 quotes 卿昔在鄯州; the speech refers to Shanzhou, and Shanzhou fits the following remark that the western border is cleared.
Literal of s0086 has the same 在鄯州; Zhengzhou is wrong and Shanzhou is correct.
s0035 names 崔暹; 暹 is Xian, not Xuan (宣), so Cui Xian is the correct English form.
Literal of s0035 likewise must render 崔暹 as Cui Xian rather than Cui Xuan.
s0036 opens with 暹 referring to the same 崔暹; the subject should be Xian, not Xuan.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0007 shows English Cui Xuan came only from misreading 暹; the personal-name claim must use Cui Xian while keeping zh, pinyin, id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence.
Accepted r0007/r0009 show the given-name English Xuan is wrong for 暹; revise it to Xian without changing zh or other claim fields.
